For the materiality assessment, the Group reached out to the members of the Governance Group for the ESG Report and five other stakeholder groups (employees, major shareholders and investors, customers, suppliers, and the public) via a materiality survey. The Group followed the four-stage process described below when conducting the materiality assessment.
